# A turnip half out of the earth: a pale faceted bulb and a tuft of three leaves. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bulb --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.15 --location 0 0 0.08
material new Bulb --base-color 0.627 0.725 0.729
material assign Bulb
add mesh cube --name L0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0.35
scale 0.1 0.04 0.4
apply --scale
set rotation 0 15 0
add mesh cube --name L1 --size 1 --location 0.06 0.04 0.32
scale 0.1 0.04 0.36
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -18 60
add mesh cube --name L2 --size 1 --location -0.06 0.04 0.32
scale 0.1 0.04 0.36
apply --scale
set rotation 0 18 -60
material new Leaf --base-color 0.310 0.467 0.329
select L0 L1 L2
material assign Leaf
select all
shade flat
export turnip.glb
